questions.question: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was launched in:
questions.rationale: Announced on 15 August 2014 and launched on 28 August 2014 by the Ministry of Finance.

questions.question: From which place was Beti Bachao Beti Padhao launched on 22 January 2015?
questions.rationale: Panipat in Haryana. Ballia hosted Ujjwala (2016), Ranchi hosted PM-JAY (2018) and Jhunjhunu hosted Poshan Abhiyaan (2018).

questions.question: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana provides:
options: LPG connections to women from poor households
questions.rationale: Ujjwala (1 May 2016) is run by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

questions.question: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY offers health cover of how much per family per year?
questions.rationale: The cover is Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals; the scheme began on 23 September 2018 at Ranchi.

questions.question: Which scheme gives Rs 6,000 a year to farmer families in three instalments?
questions.rationale: PM-KISAN was launched in February 2019 under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a 2015 launch?
questions.rationale: Make in India began on 25 September 2014. The other three started in 2015.

questions.question: Atal Pension Yojana, PM Suraksha Bima Yojana and PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana were launched in:
questions.rationale: The social-security trio was launched on 9 May 2015.

questions.question: The Jal Jeevan Mission aims at providing:
options: Tap water connection to rural households
questions.rationale: JJM was launched in August 2019 under the Ministry of Jal Shakti, with 55 litres per person per day.

questions.question: Which pair of scheme and ministry is correct?
questions.rationale: Ujjwala sits under Petroleum and Natural Gas, PM-JAY under Health and PM-KISAN under Agriculture.

questions.question: Which scheme began on 2 October 2014?
questions.rationale: Swachh Bharat Mission began on Gandhi Jayanti, 2 October 2014.

questions.question: PM SVANidhi, launched in 2020, offers working-capital loans to:
questions.rationale: It is run by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs for street vendors.

questions.question: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) began in:
questions.rationale: ICDS began on 2 October 1975. The Mid-Day Meal went nationwide in 1995.

questions.question: The Mid-Day Meal Scheme went nationwide in which year?
questions.rationale: 15 August 1995. It is now called PM POSHAN.

questions.question: PM Vishwakarma, started on 17 September 2023, is meant for:
questions.rationale: It supports traditional artisans and craftspeople and is linked to the Ministry of MSME.

questions.question: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana is concerned with:
questions.rationale: It was launched in February 2024 under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
